config.design: Full crossed16x16 source-error and destination-context matrix at each length and budget. Adaptive write-PCA error directions only, no outcome selection. Apply identical source error to every destination, estimate local directional Fisher with full vocabulary variance of numerical derivative. Compare diagonal against mean across destinations, mean excluding same source, and H764 global. Both finite-difference steps retained.
config.limitations: Reused small validation panel, length-matched swaps only; no learned conditional metric; numerical derivatives; correlation can arise from error/context coupling or heterogeneous sensitivity.
